overall_notes: This paper focuses on structured numerical extraction from clinical trial papers rather than traditional NLG tasks. The generation component produces structured YAML outputs with numerical evidence, which qualifies as NLG. The paper uses comprehensive automatic metrics and human evaluation with detailed annotation guidelines. All metadata was accurately extracted with minor normalization needed.
